title: Value of <componentParameters> on a LightningWebComponent widget
description: A JSON object written as the element's text. `properties` is itself a JSON object serialised to a STRING (double-encoded). Build it with json.dumps({'componentApiName': 'c:name', 'properties': json.dumps({...})}).

componentApiName.description: namespace:componentName, e.g. c:pipelineWidget. The component must declare the analytics__Dashboard target.

properties.description: Serialised JSON object of the component's targetConfig property values; "{}" when there are none. Tested with string values only.
